description:
Outcome-first view of reasoning (thinking) effort across Codex, Oh My Pi and Claude Code: what it multiplies in cost, steps and time, and whether heavier reasoning is followed by cleaner task completion or by more friction and rework.
Tasks are user-initiated agent runs; cost is price-weighted by the dashboard price variables; clean completion is a friction-based proxy; effort is user-chosen, so compare within a harness and model and read differences as signals to investigate, not causal proof. Check info icons for producer boundaries.

    CAST(NULL AS Nullable(UInt8)) AS errored
  FROM signoz_traces.distributed_signoz_index_v3
  WHERE timestamp BETWEEN fromUnixTimestamp64Nano($start_timestamp_nano) AND fromUnixTimestamp64Nano($end_timestamp_nano) AND serviceName IN $service_name AND serviceName IN ('codex-app-server','codex_exec','codex_cli_rs')

    if(mapContains(attributes_number,'output_token_count'),attributes_number['output_token_count'],toFloat64OrZero(attributes_string['output_token_count'])) AS outp, toNullable(if(mapContains(attributes_number,'reasoning_token_count'),attributes_number['reasoning_token_count'],toFloat64OrZero(attributes_string['reasoning_token_count']))) AS rsn,
    toFloat64(0) AS dur_s
  FROM signoz_logs.distributed_logs_v2
  WHERE timestamp BETWEEN $start_timestamp_nano AND $end_timestamp_nano AND resource.`service.name`::String IN $service_name AND resource.`service.name`::String IN ('codex-app-server','codex_exec','codex_cli_rs')

    AND (mapContains(attributes_number,'input_token_count') OR mapContains(attributes_string,'input_token_count'))

codex_calls AS (
  SELECT t.harness AS harness, t.task_id AS task_id, '' AS agent, c.ts AS ts, c.inp AS inp, c.cin AS cin, c.outp AS outp, c.rsn AS rsn, c.dur_s AS dur_s
  FROM codex_tasks AS t INNER JOIN codex_events AS c ON c.harness=t.harness AND c.conv=t.native_session_id
  WHERE c.ts >= t.start_nano AND c.ts <= t.end_nano AND (c.inp>0 OR c.outp>0)
),
omp_runs AS (
  SELECT traceID AS task_id, spanID AS root_span, toUInt64(toUnixTimestamp64Nano(timestamp)) AS start_nano, toUInt64(toUnixTimestamp64Nano(timestamp))+duration_nano AS end_nano,
    attributes_string['gen_ai.conversation.id'] AS native_session_id, multiIf(lower(attributes_string['gen_ai.provider.name']) LIKE '%anthropic%','Anthropic',lower(attributes_string['gen_ai.provider.name']) LIKE '%openai%','OpenAI',attributes_string['gen_ai.provider.name']) AS provider, attributes_string['gen_ai.request.model'] AS model,
    duration_nano/1000000000 AS duration_seconds,
    toNullable(toUInt8(attributes_number['pi.gen_ai.agent.chats.stop_reason.aborted.count']>0)) AS interrupted,
    toNullable(toUInt8(attributes_number['pi.gen_ai.agent.chats.stop_reason.error.count']>0)) AS errored
  FROM signoz_traces.distributed_signoz_index_v3
  WHERE timestamp BETWEEN fromUnixTimestamp64Nano($start_timestamp_nano) AND fromUnixTimestamp64Nano($end_timestamp_nano) AND 'oh-my-pi' IN $service_name AND serviceName='oh-my-pi'
    AND name='invoke_agent' AND parentSpanID='' AND attributes_string['gen_ai.conversation.id']!='' AND attributes_string['gen_ai.request.model']!=''
),
omp_chats AS (
  SELECT traceID AS task_id, parentSpanID AS agent, toUInt64(toUnixTimestamp64Nano(timestamp)) AS ts, attributes_string['pi.gen_ai.request.reasoning.effort'] AS effort_raw,
    attributes_number['gen_ai.usage.input_tokens'] AS inp,
    if(mapContains(attributes_number,'gen_ai.usage.cache_read.input_tokens'),attributes_number['gen_ai.usage.cache_read.input_tokens'],0) AS cin,
    attributes_number['gen_ai.usage.output_tokens'] AS outp,
    multiIf(lower(attributes_string['gen_ai.provider.name']) LIKE '%anthropic%', CAST(NULL AS Nullable(Float64)),
      mapContains(attributes_number,'gen_ai.usage.reasoning.output_tokens'), toNullable(attributes_number['gen_ai.usage.reasoning.output_tokens']),
      toNullable(toFloat64(0))) AS rsn,
    duration_nano/1000000000 AS dur_s
  FROM signoz_traces.distributed_signoz_index_v3
  WHERE timestamp BETWEEN fromUnixTimestamp64Nano($start_timestamp_nano) AND fromUnixTimestamp64Nano($end_timestamp_nano) AND 'oh-my-pi' IN $service_name AND serviceName='oh-my-pi' AND attributes_string['gen_ai.operation.name']='chat'
    AND traceID IN (SELECT task_id FROM omp_runs)
),
omp_delegations AS (
  SELECT traceID AS task_id, count() AS delegations
  FROM signoz_traces.distributed_signoz_index_v3
  WHERE timestamp BETWEEN fromUnixTimestamp64Nano($start_timestamp_nano) AND fromUnixTimestamp64Nano($end_timestamp_nano) AND 'oh-my-pi' IN $service_name AND serviceName='oh-my-pi' AND name LIKE 'invoke_agent %' AND name NOT LIKE 'invoke_agent Advisor:%'
  GROUP BY task_id
),
omp_tasks AS (
  SELECT r.start_nano AS start_nano, r.end_nano AS end_nano, 'oh-my-pi' AS harness, r.native_session_id AS native_session_id, r.task_id AS task_id,

    multiIf(length(e.efforts)=0,'unset',length(e.efforts)>1,'mixed',e.efforts[1]) AS effort,
    r.duration_seconds AS duration_seconds, toUInt64(d.delegations) AS delegations, r.interrupted AS interrupted, r.errored AS errored
  FROM omp_runs AS r
  LEFT JOIN (SELECT task_id, agent, groupUniqArrayIf(effort_raw,effort_raw!='') AS efforts FROM omp_chats GROUP BY task_id, agent) AS e ON e.task_id=r.task_id AND e.agent=r.root_span
  LEFT JOIN omp_delegations AS d ON d.task_id=r.task_id
),
omp_calls AS (
  SELECT 'oh-my-pi' AS harness, task_id, agent, ts, inp, cin, outp, rsn, dur_s FROM omp_chats WHERE inp>0 OR outp>0
),
claude_events AS (
  SELECT attributes_string['prompt.id'] AS task_id, attributes_string['session.id'] AS native_session_id, timestamp AS ts, attributes_string['model'] AS model,
    attributes_string['effort'] AS effort_raw,
    attributes_number['input_tokens']+attributes_number['cache_creation_tokens']+attributes_number['cache_read_tokens'] AS inp,
    attributes_number['cache_read_tokens'] AS cin, attributes_number['output_tokens'] AS outp, CAST(NULL AS Nullable(Float64)) AS rsn,
    if(mapContains(attributes_number,'duration_ms'),attributes_number['duration_ms'],toFloat64OrZero(attributes_string['duration_ms']))/1000 AS dur_s
  FROM signoz_logs.distributed_logs_v2
  WHERE timestamp BETWEEN $start_timestamp_nano AND $end_timestamp_nano AND 'claude-code' IN $service_name AND resource.`service.name`::String='claude-code'
    AND attributes_string['event.name']='api_request' AND attributes_string['prompt.id']!='' AND attributes_string['session.id']!=''
),
claude_errors AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT attributes_string['prompt.id'] AS task_id
  FROM signoz_logs.distributed_logs_v2
  WHERE timestamp BETWEEN $start_timestamp_nano AND $end_timestamp_nano AND 'claude-code' IN $service_name AND resource.`service.name`::String='claude-code'
    AND attributes_string['event.name'] IN ('api_error','api_retries_exhausted') AND attributes_string['prompt.id']!=''
),
claude_tasks AS (
  SELECT toUInt64(min(ts - least(ts, toUInt64(dur_s*1000000000)))) AS start_nano, toUInt64(max(ts)) AS end_nano, 'claude-code' AS harness, any(native_session_id) AS native_session_id, task_id,
    'Anthropic' AS provider, argMax(model, outp) AS model,
    if(countIf(effort_raw!='')=0,'unset',topKIf(1)(effort_raw,effort_raw!='')[1]) AS effort,
    toFloat64(max(ts) - min(ts - least(ts, toUInt64(dur_s*1000000000))))/1000000000 AS duration_seconds, toUInt64(0) AS delegations,
    CAST(NULL AS Nullable(UInt8)) AS interrupted, toNullable(toUInt8(task_id IN (SELECT task_id FROM claude_errors))) AS errored
  FROM claude_events GROUP BY task_id
),
claude_calls AS (
  SELECT 'claude-code' AS harness, task_id, '' AS agent, ts, inp, cin, outp, rsn, dur_s FROM claude_events WHERE inp>0 OR outp>0
),
task_calls AS (
  SELECT *,
    first_value(inp) OVER (PARTITION BY harness, task_id, agent ORDER BY ts ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS agent_first_input,
    first_value(agent) OVER (PARTITION BY harness, task_id ORDER BY ts ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS main_agent,
    if(inp>0, ((inp-cin)*toFloat64OrZero($price_input) + cin*toFloat64OrZero($price_cached_input))/inp, 0) AS input_price
  FROM (SELECT * FROM codex_calls UNION ALL SELECT * FROM omp_calls UNION ALL SELECT * FROM claude_calls)
),
task_costs AS (
  SELECT harness, task_id, count() AS model_steps, sum(inp) AS input_tokens, sum(cin) AS cached_input, sum(outp) AS output_tokens,
    if(countIf(isNotNull(rsn))=0, CAST(NULL AS Nullable(Float64)), sum(coalesce(rsn,0))) AS reasoning_tokens,
    sum(dur_s) AS model_seconds,
    sum(least(inp, agent_first_input)*input_price) AS cost_inherited,
    sum((inp-least(inp, agent_first_input))*input_price) AS cost_growth,
    sum((outp-coalesce(rsn,0))*toFloat64OrZero($price_output)) AS cost_visible_output,
    sum(coalesce(rsn,0)*toFloat64OrZero($price_output)) AS cost_reasoning,
    argMinIf(inp, ts, agent=main_agent) AS inherited_context,
    if(countIf(agent=main_agent)>1, (argMaxIf(inp, ts, agent=main_agent)-argMinIf(inp, ts, agent=main_agent))/(countIf(agent=main_agent)-1), NULL) AS growth_per_step
  FROM task_calls GROUP BY harness, task_id
),
codex_model_time AS (
  SELECT attributes_string['turn_id'] AS task_id, sum(duration_nano)/1000000000 AS seconds
  FROM signoz_traces.distributed_signoz_index_v3
  WHERE timestamp BETWEEN fromUnixTimestamp64Nano($start_timestamp_nano) AND fromUnixTimestamp64Nano($end_timestamp_nano) AND serviceName IN $service_name AND serviceName IN ('codex-app-server','codex_exec','codex_cli_rs') AND name='run_sampling_request' AND attributes_string['turn_id']!=''
  GROUP BY task_id
),
reasoning_tasks AS (
  SELECT t.start_nano AS start_nano, t.end_nano AS end_nano, t.harness AS harness, t.native_session_id AS native_session_id, t.task_id AS task_id,
    t.provider AS provider, t.model AS model, t.effort AS effort, t.duration_seconds AS duration_seconds, t.delegations AS delegations,
    t.interrupted AS interrupted, t.errored AS errored, coalesce(c.model_steps,0) AS model_steps, coalesce(c.input_tokens,0) AS input_tokens, coalesce(c.cached_input,0) AS cached_input,
    coalesce(c.output_tokens,0) AS output_tokens,
    if(t.harness='claude-code', CAST(NULL AS Nullable(Float64)), c.reasoning_tokens) AS reasoning_tokens,
    if(t.harness IN ('codex-app-server','codex_exec','codex_cli_rs'), coalesce(m.seconds,0), coalesce(c.model_seconds,0)) AS model_seconds,
    coalesce(c.cost_inherited,0) AS cost_inherited, coalesce(c.cost_growth,0) AS cost_growth,
    coalesce(c.cost_visible_output,0) AS cost_visible_output, coalesce(c.cost_reasoning,0) AS cost_reasoning,
    coalesce(c.cost_inherited,0)+coalesce(c.cost_growth,0)+coalesce(c.cost_visible_output,0)+coalesce(c.cost_reasoning,0) AS cost_units,
    c.inherited_context AS inherited_context, c.growth_per_step AS growth_per_step
  FROM (SELECT * FROM codex_tasks UNION ALL SELECT * FROM omp_tasks UNION ALL SELECT * FROM claude_tasks) AS t
  LEFT JOIN task_costs AS c ON c.harness=t.harness AND c.task_id=t.task_id
  LEFT JOIN codex_model_time AS m ON m.task_id=t.task_id
),
task_outcomes AS (
  SELECT *, if(harness='codex_exec',NULL,toUInt8(next_start_nano>0 AND next_start_nano<=end_nano+600000000000)) AS quick_follow_up,
    if(harness='codex_exec',NULL,toUInt8(coalesce(interrupted,0)=0 AND coalesce(errored,0)=0 AND quick_follow_up=0)) AS clean_completion,
    multiIf(effort='low',1,effort='medium',2,effort='high',3,effort='xhigh',4,0) AS effort_rank
  FROM (
    SELECT *, leadInFrame(start_nano,1,toUInt64(0)) OVER (PARTITION BY harness,native_session_id ORDER BY start_nano ROWS BETWEEN CURRENT ROW AND 1 FOLLOWING) AS next_start_nano
    FROM reasoning_tasks
  )
)
SELECT quantileExact(0.5)(cost_units) AS `Median cost per task` FROM task_outcomes

    coalesce(c.cost_visible_output,0) AS cost_visible_output, coalesce(c.cost_reasoning,0) AS cost_reasoning,
    coalesce(c.cost_inherited,0)+coalesce(c.cost_growth,0)+coalesce(c.cost_visible_output,0)+coalesce(c.cost_reasoning,0) AS cost_units,

    FROM reasoning_tasks

    argMinIf(inp, ts, agent=main_agent) AS inherited_context,
    if(countIf(agent=main_agent)>1, (argMaxIf(inp, ts, agent=main_agent)-argMinIf(inp, ts, agent=main_agent))/(countIf(agent=main_agent)-1), NULL) AS growth_per_step
  FROM task_calls GROUP BY harness, task_id

codex_model_time AS (

  FROM signoz_traces.distributed_signoz_index_v3

    if(t.harness IN ('codex-app-server','codex_exec','codex_cli_rs'), coalesce(m.seconds,0), coalesce(c.model_seconds,0)) AS model_seconds,
    coalesce(c.cost_inherited,0) AS cost_inherited, coalesce(c.cost_growth,0) AS cost_growth,
    coalesce(c.cost_visible_output,0) AS cost_visible_output, coalesce(c.cost_reasoning,0) AS cost_reasoning,
    coalesce(c.cost_inherited,0)+coalesce(c.cost_growth,0)+coalesce(c.cost_visible_output,0)+coalesce(c.cost_reasoning,0) AS cost_units,
    c.inherited_context AS inherited_context, c.growth_per_step AS growth_per_step
  FROM (SELECT * FROM codex_tasks UNION ALL SELECT * FROM omp_tasks UNION ALL SELECT * FROM claude_tasks) AS t
  LEFT JOIN task_costs AS c ON c.harness=t.harness AND c.task_id=t.task_id

  SELECT *, if(harness='codex_exec',NULL,toUInt8(next_start_nano>0 AND next_start_nano<=end_nano+600000000000)) AS quick_follow_up,

    multiIf(effort='low',1,effort='medium',2,effort='high',3,effort='xhigh',4,0) AS effort_rank

    FROM reasoning_tasks
  )

FROM task_outcomes
WHERE $end_timestamp_nano-$start_timestamp_nano >= 86400000000000
GROUP BY timestamp,series
ORDER BY timestamp,series

widgets.title: Daily Task Mix by Effort

widgets.description: Does more reasoning buy better outcomes? Compare rows within a harness: clean completion and friction against duration, model time, steps, and cost per task. Clean completion (proxy) = not interrupted, not ended on an error, and no new task in the same session within 10 minutes of it ending. It infers accepted work from absence of friction; it does not read prompt content. Headless Codex Exec runs have no user in the loop, so their clean completion and follow-up stay blank. Claude Code emits no interrupt event, so its clean completion is an upper bound. Errored is blank for Codex because turns emit no terminal error signal; Interrupted is blank for Claude Code because it emits no interrupt event. Model time is the summed duration of the task's model calls (Codex run_sampling_request spans, which also cover retries and in-flight tool draining; Oh My Pi chat spans; Claude Code api_request durations); it can exceed wall-clock duration when subagents call models in parallel. Avg reasoning tokens is blank for Claude Code, which does not report them. Rows with fewer tasks than the min_tasks variable are flagged Low sample; read them as anecdotes. Effort is chosen per task, so harder tasks may attract higher effort; treat differences as signals to investigate, not causal proof.

claude_events AS (

    AND attributes_string['event.name'] IN ('api_error','api_retries_exhausted') AND attributes_string['prompt.id']!=''

codex_model_time AS (
  SELECT attributes_string['turn_id'] AS task_id, sum(duration_nano)/1000000000 AS seconds
  FROM signoz_traces.distributed_signoz_index_v3
  WHERE timestamp BETWEEN fromUnixTimestamp64Nano($start_timestamp_nano) AND fromUnixTimestamp64Nano($end_timestamp_nano) AND serviceName IN $service_name AND serviceName IN ('codex-app-server','codex_exec','codex_cli_rs') AND name='run_sampling_request' AND attributes_string['turn_id']!=''
  GROUP BY task_id
),
reasoning_tasks AS (
  SELECT t.start_nano AS start_nano, t.end_nano AS end_nano, t.harness AS harness, t.native_session_id AS native_session_id, t.task_id AS task_id,
    t.provider AS provider, t.model AS model, t.effort AS effort, t.duration_seconds AS duration_seconds, t.delegations AS delegations,
    t.interrupted AS interrupted, t.errored AS errored, coalesce(c.model_steps,0) AS model_steps, coalesce(c.input_tokens,0) AS input_tokens, coalesce(c.cached_input,0) AS cached_input,

    coalesce(c.cost_visible_output,0) AS cost_visible_output, coalesce(c.cost_reasoning,0) AS cost_reasoning,
    coalesce(c.cost_inherited,0)+coalesce(c.cost_growth,0)+coalesce(c.cost_visible_output,0)+coalesce(c.cost_reasoning,0) AS cost_units,
    c.inherited_context AS inherited_context, c.growth_per_step AS growth_per_step
  FROM (SELECT * FROM codex_tasks UNION ALL SELECT * FROM omp_tasks UNION ALL SELECT * FROM claude_tasks) AS t
  LEFT JOIN task_costs AS c ON c.harness=t.harness AND c.task_id=t.task_id
  LEFT JOIN codex_model_time AS m ON m.task_id=t.task_id
),
task_outcomes AS (
  SELECT *, if(harness='codex_exec',NULL,toUInt8(next_start_nano>0 AND next_start_nano<=end_nano+600000000000)) AS quick_follow_up,
    if(harness='codex_exec',NULL,toUInt8(coalesce(interrupted,0)=0 AND coalesce(errored,0)=0 AND quick_follow_up=0)) AS clean_completion,
    multiIf(effort='low',1,effort='medium',2,effort='high',3,effort='xhigh',4,0) AS effort_rank
  FROM (
    SELECT *, leadInFrame(start_nano,1,toUInt64(0)) OVER (PARTITION BY harness,native_session_id ORDER BY start_nano ROWS BETWEEN CURRENT ROW AND 1 FOLLOWING) AS next_start_nano
    FROM reasoning_tasks
  )
)
SELECT multiIf(harness='codex-app-server','Codex App',harness='codex_exec','Codex Exec',harness='codex_cli_rs','Codex CLI',harness='oh-my-pi','OMP',harness='claude-code','Claude Code',harness) AS `Harness`, effort AS `Effort`, count() AS `Tasks`, if(count() < toUInt64OrZero($min_tasks), 'yes', 'no') AS `Low sample`,
  round(100*avg(clean_completion),1) AS `Clean completion`, round(100*avg(interrupted),1) AS `Interrupted`, round(100*avg(quick_follow_up),1) AS `Quick follow-up`, round(100*avg(errored),1) AS `Errored`,
  round(quantileExact(0.5)(duration_seconds),1) AS `P50 duration`, round(quantileExact(0.9)(duration_seconds),1) AS `P90 duration`,
  round(quantileExact(0.5)(model_seconds),1) AS `P50 model time`, round(100*sum(model_seconds)/nullIf(sum(duration_seconds),0),1) AS `Model time share`,
  round(avg(model_steps),1) AS `Avg model steps`, round(quantileExact(0.5)(cost_units)) AS `Median cost`,
  round(avg(reasoning_tokens)) AS `Avg reasoning tokens`, round(avg(output_tokens)) AS `Avg output tokens`
FROM task_outcomes
GROUP BY harness,effort
ORDER BY `Harness`,multiIf(effort='unset',0,effort='low',1,effort='medium',2,effort='high',3,effort='xhigh',4,5)

widgets.title: Task Outcomes by Reasoning Effort

widgets.description: How much each effort level multiplies task cost and model steps within the same harness and model, against the lowest effort (low → xhigh) with at least min_tasks tasks.   FROM per_effort AS p LEFT JOIN baseline AS b ON b.harness=p.harness AND b.model=p.model

ORDER BY `Harness`, `Model`, multiIf(effort='unset',0,effort='low',1,effort='medium',2,effort='high',3,effort='xhigh',4,5)

    if(mapContains(attributes_number,'duration_ms'),attributes_number['duration_ms'],toFloat64OrZero(attributes_string['duration_ms']))/1000 AS dur_s
  FROM signoz_logs.distributed_logs_v2
  WHERE timestamp BETWEEN $start_timestamp_nano AND $end_timestamp_nano AND 'claude-code' IN $service_name AND resource.`service.name`::String='claude-code'
    AND attributes_string['event.name']='api_request' AND attributes_string['prompt.id']!='' AND attributes_string['session.id']!=''
),
claude_errors AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT attributes_string['prompt.id'] AS task_id
  FROM signoz_logs.distributed_logs_v2
  WHERE timestamp BETWEEN $start_timestamp_nano AND $end_timestamp_nano AND 'claude-code' IN $service_name AND resource.`service.name`::String='claude-code'
    AND attributes_string['event.name'] IN ('api_error','api_retries_exhausted') AND attributes_string['prompt.id']!=''
),
claude_tasks AS (
  SELECT toUInt64(min(ts - least(ts, toUInt64(dur_s*1000000000)))) AS start_nano, toUInt64(max(ts)) AS end_nano, 'claude-code' AS harness, any(native_session_id) AS native_session_id, task_id,
    'Anthropic' AS provider, argMax(model, outp) AS model,
    if(countIf(effort_raw!='')=0,'unset',topKIf(1)(effort_raw,effort_raw!='')[1]) AS effort,
    toFloat64(max(ts) - min(ts - least(ts, toUInt64(dur_s*1000000000))))/1000000000 AS duration_seconds, toUInt64(0) AS delegations,
    CAST(NULL AS Nullable(UInt8)) AS interrupted, toNullable(toUInt8(task_id IN (SELECT task_id FROM claude_errors))) AS errored
  FROM claude_events GROUP BY task_id
),
claude_calls AS (
  SELECT 'claude-code' AS harness, task_id, '' AS agent, ts, inp, cin, outp, rsn, dur_s FROM claude_events WHERE inp>0 OR outp>0
),
task_calls AS (
  SELECT *,
    first_value(inp) OVER (PARTITION BY harness, task_id, agent ORDER BY ts ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS agent_first_input,
    first_value(agent) OVER (PARTITION BY harness, task_id ORDER BY ts ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS main_agent,
    if(inp>0, ((inp-cin)*toFloat64OrZero($price_input) + cin*toFloat64OrZero($price_cached_input))/inp, 0) AS input_price
  FROM (SELECT * FROM codex_calls UNION ALL SELECT * FROM omp_calls UNION ALL SELECT * FROM claude_calls)
),
task_costs AS (
  SELECT harness, task_id, count() AS model_steps, sum(inp) AS input_tokens, sum(cin) AS cached_input, sum(outp) AS output_tokens,
    if(countIf(isNotNull(rsn))=0, CAST(NULL AS Nullable(Float64)), sum(coalesce(rsn,0))) AS reasoning_tokens,
    sum(dur_s) AS model_seconds,
    sum(least(inp, agent_first_input)*input_price) AS cost_inherited,
    sum((inp-least(inp, agent_first_input))*input_price) AS cost_growth,
    sum((outp-coalesce(rsn,0))*toFloat64OrZero($price_output)) AS cost_visible_output,
    sum(coalesce(rsn,0)*toFloat64OrZero($price_output)) AS cost_reasoning,
    argMinIf(inp, ts, agent=main_agent) AS inherited_context,
    if(countIf(agent=main_agent)>1, (argMaxIf(inp, ts, agent=main_agent)-argMinIf(inp, ts, agent=main_agent))/(countIf(agent=main_agent)-1), NULL) AS growth_per_step
  FROM task_calls GROUP BY harness, task_id
),
codex_model_time AS (
  SELECT attributes_string['turn_id'] AS task_id, sum(duration_nano)/1000000000 AS seconds
  FROM signoz_traces.distributed_signoz_index_v3
  WHERE timestamp BETWEEN fromUnixTimestamp64Nano($start_timestamp_nano) AND fromUnixTimestamp64Nano($end_timestamp_nano) AND serviceName IN $service_name AND serviceName IN ('codex-app-server','codex_exec','codex_cli_rs') AND name='run_sampling_request' AND attributes_string['turn_id']!=''
  GROUP BY task_id
),
reasoning_tasks AS (
  SELECT t.start_nano AS start_nano, t.end_nano AS end_nano, t.harness AS harness, t.native_session_id AS native_session_id, t.task_id AS task_id,
    t.provider AS provider, t.model AS model, t.effort AS effort, t.duration_seconds AS duration_seconds, t.delegations AS delegations,
    t.interrupted AS interrupted, t.errored AS errored, coalesce(c.model_steps,0) AS model_steps, coalesce(c.input_tokens,0) AS input_tokens, coalesce(c.cached_input,0) AS cached_input,
    coalesce(c.output_tokens,0) AS output_tokens,
    if(t.harness='claude-code', CAST(NULL AS Nullable(Float64)), c.reasoning_tokens) AS reasoning_tokens,
    if(t.harness IN ('codex-app-server','codex_exec','codex_cli_rs'), coalesce(m.seconds,0), coalesce(c.model_seconds,0)) AS model_seconds,
    coalesce(c.cost_inherited,0) AS cost_inherited, coalesce(c.cost_growth,0) AS cost_growth,
    coalesce(c.cost_visible_output,0) AS cost_visible_output, coalesce(c.cost_reasoning,0) AS cost_reasoning,
    coalesce(c.cost_inherited,0)+coalesce(c.cost_growth,0)+coalesce(c.cost_visible_output,0)+coalesce(c.cost_reasoning,0) AS cost_units,
    c.inherited_context AS inherited_context, c.growth_per_step AS growth_per_step
  FROM (SELECT * FROM codex_tasks UNION ALL SELECT * FROM omp_tasks UNION ALL SELECT * FROM claude_tasks) AS t
  LEFT JOIN task_costs AS c ON c.harness=t.harness AND c.task_id=t.task_id
  LEFT JOIN codex_model_time AS m ON m.task_id=t.task_id
),
task_outcomes AS (
  SELECT *, if(harness='codex_exec',NULL,toUInt8(next_start_nano>0 AND next_start_nano<=end_nano+600000000000)) AS quick_follow_up,
    if(harness='codex_exec',NULL,toUInt8(coalesce(interrupted,0)=0 AND coalesce(errored,0)=0 AND quick_follow_up=0)) AS clean_completion,
    multiIf(effort='low',1,effort='medium',2,effort='high',3,effort='xhigh',4,0) AS effort_rank
  FROM (
    SELECT *, leadInFrame(start_nano,1,toUInt64(0)) OVER (PARTITION BY harness,native_session_id ORDER BY start_nano ROWS BETWEEN CURRENT ROW AND 1 FOLLOWING) AS next_start_nano
    FROM reasoning_tasks
  )
)
SELECT multiIf(harness='codex-app-server','Codex App',harness='codex_exec','Codex Exec',harness='codex_cli_rs','Codex CLI',harness='oh-my-pi','OMP',harness='claude-code','Claude Code',harness) AS `Harness`, effort AS `Effort`, count() AS `Tasks`, if(count() < toUInt64OrZero($min_tasks), 'yes', 'no') AS `Low sample`,
  round(100*sum(cost_inherited)/nullIf(sum(cost_units),0),1) AS `Inherited`, round(100*sum(cost_growth)/nullIf(sum(cost_units),0),1) AS `Growth`,
  round(100*sum(cost_visible_output)/nullIf(sum(cost_units),0),1) AS `Visible output`,
  if(countIf(isNotNull(reasoning_tokens))=0, NULL, round(100*sum(cost_reasoning)/nullIf(sum(cost_units),0),1)) AS `Reasoning`,
  round(quantileExact(0.5)(inherited_context)) AS `Median inherited context`, round(quantileExact(0.5)(growth_per_step)) AS `Median growth per step`
FROM task_outcomes
GROUP BY harness, effort
ORDER BY `Harness`, multiIf(effort='unset',0,effort='low',1,effort='medium',2,effort='high',3,effort='xhigh',4,5)

widgets.description: Rank (Spearman) correlation per task within each harness and model, using ranked effort levels low → xhigh: does higher effort go with more steps and higher cost, and does reasoning per step go with more steps? +1 is a perfect increasing relationship, 0 none. Blank when fewer than min_tasks tasks, fewer than two effort levels, or reasoning is not reported. Correlation is not causation.

clickhouse_sql.query:
WITH codex_interrupts AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT attributes_string['turn.id'] AS task_id
  FROM signoz_traces.distributed_signoz_index_v3
  WHERE timestamp BETWEEN fromUnixTimestamp64Nano($start_timestamp_nano) AND fromUnixTimestamp64Nano($end_timestamp_nano) AND serviceName IN $service_name AND serviceName IN ('codex-app-server','codex_exec','codex_cli_rs') AND name='turn/interrupt' AND attributes_string['turn.id']!=''
),
codex_tasks AS (
  SELECT toUInt64(toUnixTimestamp64Nano(timestamp)) AS start_nano, toUInt64(toUnixTimestamp64Nano(timestamp))+duration_nano AS end_nano,
    serviceName AS harness, attributes_string['thread.id'] AS native_session_id, attributes_string['turn.id'] AS task_id, 'OpenAI' AS provider, attributes_string['model'] AS model,
    if(attributes_string['codex.turn.reasoning_effort']='','unset',attributes_string['codex.turn.reasoning_effort']) AS effort,
    duration_nano/1000000000 AS duration_seconds, toUInt64(0) AS delegations,
    toNullable(toUInt8(attributes_string['turn.id'] IN (SELECT task_id FROM codex_interrupts))) AS interrupted,
    CAST(NULL AS Nullable(UInt8)) AS errored
  FROM signoz_traces.distributed_signoz_index_v3
  WHERE timestamp BETWEEN fromUnixTimestamp64Nano($start_timestamp_nano) AND fromUnixTimestamp64Nano($end_timestamp_nano) AND serviceName IN $service_name AND serviceName IN ('codex-app-server','codex_exec','codex_cli_rs')
    AND name='session_task.turn' AND attributes_string['turn.id']!='' AND attributes_string['thread.id']!='' AND attributes_string['model']!='' AND attributes_string['model']!='codex-auto-review'
),
codex_events AS (
  SELECT resource.`service.name`::String AS harness, attributes_string['conversation.id'] AS conv, timestamp AS ts,
    if(mapContains(attributes_number,'input_token_count'),attributes_number['input_token_count'],toFloat64OrZero(attributes_string['input_token_count'])) AS inp, if(mapContains(attributes_number,'cached_token_count'),attributes_number['cached_token_count'],toFloat64OrZero(attributes_string['cached_token_count'])) AS cin,
    if(mapContains(attributes_number,'output_token_count'),attributes_number['output_token_count'],toFloat64OrZero(attributes_string['output_token_count'])) AS outp, toNullable(if(mapContains(attributes_number,'reasoning_token_count'),attributes_number['reasoning_token_count'],toFloat64OrZero(attributes_string['reasoning_token_count']))) AS rsn,
    toFloat64(0) AS dur_s
  FROM signoz_logs.distributed_logs_v2
  WHERE timestamp BETWEEN $start_timestamp_nano AND $end_timestamp_nano AND resource.`service.name`::String IN $service_name AND resource.`service.name`::String IN ('codex-app-server','codex_exec','codex_cli_rs')
    AND attributes_string['event.name']='codex.sse_event' AND attributes_string['conversation.id']!=''
    AND (mapContains(attributes_number,'input_token_count') OR mapContains(attributes_string,'input_token_count'))
),
codex_calls AS (
  SELECT t.harness AS harness, t.task_id AS task_id, '' AS agent, c.ts AS ts, c.inp AS inp, c.cin AS cin, c.outp AS outp, c.rsn AS rsn, c.dur_s AS dur_s
  FROM codex_tasks AS t INNER JOIN codex_events AS c ON c.harness=t.harness AND c.conv=t.native_session_id
  WHERE c.ts >= t.start_nano AND c.ts <= t.end_nano AND (c.inp>0 OR c.outp>0)
),
omp_runs AS (
  SELECT traceID AS task_id, spanID AS root_span, toUInt64(toUnixTimestamp64Nano(timestamp)) AS start_nano, toUInt64(toUnixTimestamp64Nano(timestamp))+duration_nano AS end_nano,
    attributes_string['gen_ai.conversation.id'] AS native_session_id, multiIf(lower(attributes_string['gen_ai.provider.name']) LIKE '%anthropic%','Anthropic',lower(attributes_string['gen_ai.provider.name']) LIKE '%openai%','OpenAI',attributes_string['gen_ai.provider.name']) AS provider, attributes_string['gen_ai.request.model'] AS model,
    duration_nano/1000000000 AS duration_seconds,
    toNullable(toUInt8(attributes_number['pi.gen_ai.agent.chats.stop_reason.aborted.count']>0)) AS interrupted,
    toNullable(toUInt8(attributes_number['pi.gen_ai.agent.chats.stop_reason.error.count']>0)) AS errored
  FROM signoz_traces.distributed_signoz_index_v3
  WHERE timestamp BETWEEN fromUnixTimestamp64Nano($start_timestamp_nano) AND fromUnixTimestamp64Nano($end_timestamp_nano) AND 'oh-my-pi' IN $service_name AND serviceName='oh-my-pi'
    AND name='invoke_agent' AND parentSpanID='' AND attributes_string['gen_ai.conversation.id']!='' AND attributes_string['gen_ai.request.model']!=''
),
omp_chats AS (
  SELECT traceID AS task_id, parentSpanID AS agent, toUInt64(toUnixTimestamp64Nano(timestamp)) AS ts, attributes_string['pi.gen_ai.request.reasoning.effort'] AS effort_raw,
    attributes_number['gen_ai.usage.input_tokens'] AS inp,
    if(mapContains(attributes_number,'gen_ai.usage.cache_read.input_tokens'),attributes_number['gen_ai.usage.cache_read.input_tokens'],0) AS cin,
    attributes_number['gen_ai.usage.output_tokens'] AS outp,
    multiIf(lower(attributes_string['gen_ai.provider.name']) LIKE '%anthropic%', CAST(NULL AS Nullable(Float64)),
      mapContains(attributes_number,'gen_ai.usage.reasoning.output_tokens'), toNullable(attributes_number['gen_ai.usage.reasoning.output_tokens']),
      toNullable(toFloat64(0))) AS rsn,
    duration_nano/1000000000 AS dur_s
  FROM signoz_traces.distributed_signoz_index_v3
  WHERE timestamp BETWEEN fromUnixTimestamp64Nano($start_timestamp_nano) AND fromUnixTimestamp64Nano($end_timestamp_nano) AND 'oh-my-pi' IN $service_name AND serviceName='oh-my-pi' AND attributes_string['gen_ai.operation.name']='chat'
    AND traceID IN (SELECT task_id FROM omp_runs)
),
omp_delegations AS (
  SELECT traceID AS task_id, count() AS delegations
  FROM signoz_traces.distributed_signoz_index_v3
  WHERE timestamp BETWEEN fromUnixTimestamp64Nano($start_timestamp_nano) AND fromUnixTimestamp64Nano($end_timestamp_nano) AND 'oh-my-pi' IN $service_name AND serviceName='oh-my-pi' AND name LIKE 'invoke_agent %' AND name NOT LIKE 'invoke_agent Advisor:%'
  GROUP BY task_id
),
omp_tasks AS (
  SELECT r.start_nano AS start_nano, r.end_nano AS end_nano, 'oh-my-pi' AS harness, r.native_session_id AS native_session_id, r.task_id AS task_id,
    r.provider AS provider, r.model AS model,
    multiIf(length(e.efforts)=0,'unset',length(e.efforts)>1,'mixed',e.efforts[1]) AS effort,
    r.duration_seconds AS duration_seconds, toUInt64(d.delegations) AS delegations, r.interrupted AS interrupted, r.errored AS errored
  FROM omp_runs AS r
  LEFT JOIN (SELECT task_id, agent, groupUniqArrayIf(effort_raw,effort_raw!='') AS efforts FROM omp_chats GROUP BY task_id, agent) AS e ON e.task_id=r.task_id AND e.agent=r.root_span
  LEFT JOIN omp_delegations AS d ON d.task_id=r.task_id
),
omp_calls AS (
  SELECT 'oh-my-pi' AS harness, task_id, agent, ts, inp, cin, outp, rsn, dur_s FROM omp_chats WHERE inp>0 OR outp>0
),
claude_events AS (
  SELECT attributes_string['prompt.id'] AS task_id, attributes_string['session.id'] AS native_session_id, timestamp AS ts, attributes_string['model'] AS model,
    attributes_string['effort'] AS effort_raw,
    attributes_number['input_tokens']+attributes_number['cache_creation_tokens']+attributes_number['cache_read_tokens'] AS inp,
    attributes_number['cache_read_tokens'] AS cin, attributes_number['output_tokens'] AS outp, CAST(NULL AS Nullable(Float64)) AS rsn,
    if(mapContains(attributes_number,'duration_ms'),attributes_number['duration_ms'],toFloat64OrZero(attributes_string['duration_ms']))/1000 AS dur_s
  FROM signoz_logs.distributed_logs_v2
  WHERE timestamp BETWEEN $start_timestamp_nano AND $end_timestamp_nano AND 'claude-code' IN $service_name AND resource.`service.name`::String='claude-code'
    AND attributes_string['event.name']='api_request' AND attributes_string['prompt.id']!='' AND attributes_string['session.id']!=''
),
claude_errors AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT attributes_string['prompt.id'] AS task_id
  FROM signoz_logs.distributed_logs_v2
  WHERE timestamp BETWEEN $start_timestamp_nano AND $end_timestamp_nano AND 'claude-code' IN $service_name AND resource.`service.name`::String='claude-code'
    AND attributes_string['event.name'] IN ('api_error','api_retries_exhausted') AND attributes_string['prompt.id']!=''
),
claude_tasks AS (
  SELECT toUInt64(min(ts - least(ts, toUInt64(dur_s*1000000000)))) AS start_nano, toUInt64(max(ts)) AS end_nano, 'claude-code' AS harness, any(native_session_id) AS native_session_id, task_id,
    'Anthropic' AS provider, argMax(model, outp) AS model,
    if(countIf(effort_raw!='')=0,'unset',topKIf(1)(effort_raw,effort_raw!='')[1]) AS effort,
    toFloat64(max(ts) - min(ts - least(ts, toUInt64(dur_s*1000000000))))/1000000000 AS duration_seconds, toUInt64(0) AS delegations,
    CAST(NULL AS Nullable(UInt8)) AS interrupted, toNullable(toUInt8(task_id IN (SELECT task_id FROM claude_errors))) AS errored
  FROM claude_events GROUP BY task_id
),
claude_calls AS (
  SELECT 'claude-code' AS harness, task_id, '' AS agent, ts, inp, cin, outp, rsn, dur_s FROM claude_events WHERE inp>0 OR outp>0
),
task_calls AS (
  SELECT *,
    first_value(inp) OVER (PARTITION BY harness, task_id, agent ORDER BY ts ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS agent_first_input,
    first_value(agent) OVER (PARTITION BY harness, task_id ORDER BY ts ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS main_agent,
    if(inp>0, ((inp-cin)*toFloat64OrZero($price_input) + cin*toFloat64OrZero($price_cached_input))/inp, 0) AS input_price
  FROM (SELECT * FROM codex_calls UNION ALL SELECT * FROM omp_calls UNION ALL SELECT * FROM claude_calls)
),
task_costs AS (
  SELECT harness, task_id, count() AS model_steps, sum(inp) AS input_tokens, sum(cin) AS cached_input, sum(outp) AS output_tokens,
    if(countIf(isNotNull(rsn))=0, CAST(NULL AS Nullable(Float64)), sum(coalesce(rsn,0))) AS reasoning_tokens,
    sum(dur_s) AS model_seconds,
    sum(least(inp, agent_first_input)*input_price) AS cost_inherited,
    sum((inp-least(inp, agent_first_input))*input_price) AS cost_growth,
    sum((outp-coalesce(rsn,0))*toFloat64OrZero($price_output)) AS cost_visible_output,
    sum(coalesce(rsn,0)*toFloat64OrZero($price_output)) AS cost_reasoning,
    argMinIf(inp, ts, agent=main_agent) AS inherited_context,
    if(countIf(agent=main_agent)>1, (argMaxIf(inp, ts, agent=main_agent)-argMinIf(inp, ts, agent=main_agent))/(countIf(agent=main_agent)-1), NULL) AS growth_per_step
  FROM task_calls GROUP BY harness, task_id
),
codex_model_time AS (
  SELECT attributes_string['turn_id'] AS task_id, sum(duration_nano)/1000000000 AS seconds
  FROM signoz_traces.distributed_signoz_index_v3
  WHERE timestamp BETWEEN fromUnixTimestamp64Nano($start_timestamp_nano) AND fromUnixTimestamp64Nano($end_timestamp_nano) AND serviceName IN $service_name AND serviceName IN ('codex-app-server','codex_exec','codex_cli_rs') AND name='run_sampling_request' AND attributes_string['turn_id']!=''
  GROUP BY task_id
),
reasoning_tasks AS (
  SELECT t.start_nano AS start_nano, t.end_nano AS end_nano, t.harness AS harness, t.native_session_id AS native_session_id, t.task_id AS task_id,
    t.provider AS provider, t.model AS model, t.effort AS effort, t.duration_seconds AS duration_seconds, t.delegations AS delegations,
    t.interrupted AS interrupted, t.errored AS errored, coalesce(c.model_steps,0) AS model_steps, coalesce(c.input_tokens,0) AS input_tokens, coalesce(c.cached_input,0) AS cached_input,
    coalesce(c.output_tokens,0) AS output_tokens,
    if(t.harness='claude-code', CAST(NULL AS Nullable(Float64)), c.reasoning_tokens) AS reasoning_tokens,
    if(t.harness IN ('codex-app-server','codex_exec','codex_cli_rs'), coalesce(m.seconds,0), coalesce(c.model_seconds,0)) AS model_seconds,
    coalesce(c.cost_inherited,0) AS cost_inherited, coalesce(c.cost_growth,0) AS cost_growth,
    coalesce(c.cost_visible_output,0) AS cost_visible_output, coalesce(c.cost_reasoning,0) AS cost_reasoning,
    coalesce(c.cost_inherited,0)+coalesce(c.cost_growth,0)+coalesce(c.cost_visible_output,0)+coalesce(c.cost_reasoning,0) AS cost_units,
    c.inherited_context AS inherited_context, c.growth_per_step AS growth_per_step
  FROM (SELECT * FROM codex_tasks UNION ALL SELECT * FROM omp_tasks UNION ALL SELECT * FROM claude_tasks) AS t
  LEFT JOIN task_costs AS c ON c.harness=t.harness AND c.task_id=t.task_id
  LEFT JOIN codex_model_time AS m ON m.task_id=t.task_id
),
task_outcomes AS (
  SELECT *, if(harness='codex_exec',NULL,toUInt8(next_start_nano>0 AND next_start_nano<=end_nano+600000000000)) AS quick_follow_up,
    if(harness='codex_exec',NULL,toUInt8(coalesce(interrupted,0)=0 AND coalesce(errored,0)=0 AND quick_follow_up=0)) AS clean_completion,
    multiIf(effort='low',1,effort='medium',2,effort='high',3,effort='xhigh',4,0) AS effort_rank
  FROM (
    SELECT *, leadInFrame(start_nano,1,toUInt64(0)) OVER (PARTITION BY harness,native_session_id ORDER BY start_nano ROWS BETWEEN CURRENT ROW AND 1 FOLLOWING) AS next_start_nano
    FROM reasoning_tasks
  )
)
, base AS (
  SELECT harness, model, effort, toFloat64(effort_rank) AS x_effort, toFloat64(model_steps) AS x_steps, cost_units AS x_cost,
    coalesce(reasoning_tokens,0)/greatest(model_steps,1) AS x_rps, isNotNull(reasoning_tokens) AS has_rs
  FROM task_outcomes WHERE effort_rank > 0
),
ranked AS (
  SELECT *,
    rank() OVER (PARTITION BY harness, model ORDER BY x_effort) + (count() OVER (PARTITION BY harness, model, x_effort) - 1)/2 AS r_effort,
    rank() OVER (PARTITION BY harness, model ORDER BY x_steps) + (count() OVER (PARTITION BY harness, model, x_steps) - 1)/2 AS r_steps,
    rank() OVER (PARTITION BY harness, model ORDER BY x_cost) + (count() OVER (PARTITION BY harness, model, x_cost) - 1)/2 AS r_cost,
    rank() OVER (PARTITION BY harness, model, has_rs ORDER BY x_rps) + (count() OVER (PARTITION BY harness, model, has_rs, x_rps) - 1)/2 AS r_rps,
    rank() OVER (PARTITION BY harness, model, has_rs ORDER BY x_steps) + (count() OVER (PARTITION BY harness, model, has_rs, x_steps) - 1)/2 AS r_steps_rs
  FROM base
)
SELECT multiIf(harness='codex-app-server','Codex App',harness='codex_exec','Codex Exec',harness='codex_cli_rs','Codex CLI',harness='oh-my-pi','OMP',harness='claude-code','Claude Code',harness) AS `Harness`, model AS `Model`, count() AS `Tasks`, uniqExact(effort) AS `Effort levels`,
  if(count() >= toUInt64OrZero($min_tasks) AND uniqExact(effort) >= 2, if(isNaN(corr(r_effort, r_steps)), NULL, round(corr(r_effort, r_steps),2)), NULL) AS `Effort ~ steps`,
  if(count() >= toUInt64OrZero($min_tasks) AND uniqExact(effort) >= 2, if(isNaN(corr(r_effort, r_cost)), NULL, round(corr(r_effort, r_cost),2)), NULL) AS `Effort ~ cost`,
  if(count() >= toUInt64OrZero($min_tasks), if(isNaN(corr(r_steps, r_cost)), NULL, round(corr(r_steps, r_cost),2)), NULL) AS `Steps ~ cost`,
  if(countIf(has_rs) >= toUInt64OrZero($min_tasks), if(isNaN(corrIf(r_rps, r_steps_rs, has_rs)), NULL, round(corrIf(r_rps, r_steps_rs, has_rs),2)), NULL) AS `Reasoning per step ~ steps`
FROM ranked
GROUP BY harness, model
HAVING count() >= 5
ORDER BY `Harness`, `Tasks` DESC

widgets.title: Effort, Steps and Cost Correlation

widgets.description: Clean-completion rate per harness, model and effort with a 95% Wilson confidence interval: the plausible range of the true success chance given the sample. Overlapping intervals mean the data cannot yet tell the efforts apart. Clean completion (proxy) = not interrupted, not ended on an error, and no new task in the same session within 10 minutes of it ending. It infers accepted work from absence of friction; it does not read prompt content. Headless Codex Exec runs have no user in the loop, so their clean completion and follow-up stay blank. Claude Code emits no interrupt event, so its clean completion is an upper bound. Rows with fewer tasks than the min_tasks variable are flagged Low sample; read them as anecdotes.

    if(countIf(effort_raw!='')=0,'unset',topKIf(1)(effort_raw,effort_raw!='')[1]) AS effort,
    toFloat64(max(ts) - min(ts - least(ts, toUInt64(dur_s*1000000000))))/1000000000 AS duration_seconds, toUInt64(0) AS delegations,

  FROM claude_events GROUP BY task_id
),
claude_calls AS (
  SELECT 'claude-code' AS harness, task_id, '' AS agent, ts, inp, cin, outp, rsn, dur_s FROM claude_events WHERE inp>0 OR outp>0
),
task_calls AS (
  SELECT *,
    first_value(inp) OVER (PARTITION BY harness, task_id, agent ORDER BY ts ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS agent_first_input,
    first_value(agent) OVER (PARTITION BY harness, task_id ORDER BY ts ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS main_agent,
    if(inp>0, ((inp-cin)*toFloat64OrZero($price_input) + cin*toFloat64OrZero($price_cached_input))/inp, 0) AS input_price
  FROM (SELECT * FROM codex_calls UNION ALL SELECT * FROM omp_calls UNION ALL SELECT * FROM claude_calls)
),
task_costs AS (
  SELECT harness, task_id, count() AS model_steps, sum(inp) AS input_tokens, sum(cin) AS cached_input, sum(outp) AS output_tokens,

    sum(dur_s) AS model_seconds,
    sum(least(inp, agent_first_input)*input_price) AS cost_inherited,
    sum((inp-least(inp, agent_first_input))*input_price) AS cost_growth,
    sum((outp-coalesce(rsn,0))*toFloat64OrZero($price_output)) AS cost_visible_output,
    sum(coalesce(rsn,0)*toFloat64OrZero($price_output)) AS cost_reasoning,
    argMinIf(inp, ts, agent=main_agent) AS inherited_context,
    if(countIf(agent=main_agent)>1, (argMaxIf(inp, ts, agent=main_agent)-argMinIf(inp, ts, agent=main_agent))/(countIf(agent=main_agent)-1), NULL) AS growth_per_step

  GROUP BY task_id
),
reasoning_tasks AS (
  SELECT t.start_nano AS start_nano, t.end_nano AS end_nano, t.harness AS harness, t.native_session_id AS native_session_id, t.task_id AS task_id,

    coalesce(c.output_tokens,0) AS output_tokens,
    if(t.harness='claude-code', CAST(NULL AS Nullable(Float64)), c.reasoning_tokens) AS reasoning_tokens,
    if(t.harness IN ('codex-app-server','codex_exec','codex_cli_rs'), coalesce(m.seconds,0), coalesce(c.model_seconds,0)) AS model_seconds,
    coalesce(c.cost_inherited,0) AS cost_inherited, coalesce(c.cost_growth,0) AS cost_growth,
    coalesce(c.cost_visible_output,0) AS cost_visible_output, coalesce(c.cost_reasoning,0) AS cost_reasoning,
    coalesce(c.cost_inherited,0)+coalesce(c.cost_growth,0)+coalesce(c.cost_visible_output,0)+coalesce(c.cost_reasoning,0) AS cost_units,
    c.inherited_context AS inherited_context, c.growth_per_step AS growth_per_step
  FROM (SELECT * FROM codex_tasks UNION ALL SELECT * FROM omp_tasks UNION ALL SELECT * FROM claude_tasks) AS t
  LEFT JOIN task_costs AS c ON c.harness=t.harness AND c.task_id=t.task_id
  LEFT JOIN codex_model_time AS m ON m.task_id=t.task_id
),
task_outcomes AS (
  SELECT *, if(harness='codex_exec',NULL,toUInt8(next_start_nano>0 AND next_start_nano<=end_nano+600000000000)) AS quick_follow_up,
    if(harness='codex_exec',NULL,toUInt8(coalesce(interrupted,0)=0 AND coalesce(errored,0)=0 AND quick_follow_up=0)) AS clean_completion,
    multiIf(effort='low',1,effort='medium',2,effort='high',3,effort='xhigh',4,0) AS effort_rank
  FROM (
    SELECT *, leadInFrame(start_nano,1,toUInt64(0)) OVER (PARTITION BY harness,native_session_id ORDER BY start_nano ROWS BETWEEN CURRENT ROW AND 1 FOLLOWING) AS next_start_nano
    FROM reasoning_tasks
  )
)
, rates AS (
  SELECT harness, model, effort, countIf(isNotNull(clean_completion)) AS n, sumIf(clean_completion, isNotNull(clean_completion))/nullIf(n,0) AS p
  FROM task_outcomes GROUP BY harness, model, effort HAVING n > 0
)
SELECT multiIf(harness='codex-app-server','Codex App',harness='codex_exec','Codex Exec',harness='codex_cli_rs','Codex CLI',harness='oh-my-pi','OMP',harness='claude-code','Claude Code',harness) AS `Harness`, model AS `Model`, effort AS `Effort`, n AS `Tasks`, if(n < toUInt64OrZero($min_tasks), 'yes', 'no') AS `Low sample`,
  round(100*p,1) AS `Success`, round(100*greatest(0, (p + 1.9208/n - 1.96*sqrt(p*(1-p)/n + 0.9604/(n*n))) / (1 + 3.8416/n)),1) AS `CI low`, round(100*least(1, (p + 1.9208/n + 1.96*sqrt(p*(1-p)/n + 0.9604/(n*n))) / (1 + 3.8416/n)),1) AS `CI high`
FROM rates
ORDER BY `Harness`, `Model`, multiIf(effort='unset',0,effort='low',1,effort='medium',2,effort='high',3,effort='xhigh',4,5)

    CAST(NULL AS Nullable(UInt8)) AS interrupted, toNullable(toUInt8(task_id IN (SELECT task_id FROM claude_errors))) AS errored
  FROM claude_events GROUP BY task_id
),
claude_calls AS (
  SELECT 'claude-code' AS harness, task_id, '' AS agent, ts, inp, cin, outp, rsn, dur_s FROM claude_events WHERE inp>0 OR outp>0
),
task_calls AS (
  SELECT *,
    first_value(inp) OVER (PARTITION BY harness, task_id, agent ORDER BY ts ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS agent_first_input,
    first_value(agent) OVER (PARTITION BY harness, task_id ORDER BY ts ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS main_agent,
    if(inp>0, ((inp-cin)*toFloat64OrZero($price_input) + cin*toFloat64OrZero($price_cached_input))/inp, 0) AS input_price
  FROM (SELECT * FROM codex_calls UNION ALL SELECT * FROM omp_calls UNION ALL SELECT * FROM claude_calls)
),
task_costs AS (
  SELECT harness, task_id, count() AS model_steps, sum(inp) AS input_tokens, sum(cin) AS cached_input, sum(outp) AS output_tokens,
    if(countIf(isNotNull(rsn))=0, CAST(NULL AS Nullable(Float64)), sum(coalesce(rsn,0))) AS reasoning_tokens,
    sum(dur_s) AS model_seconds,

    sum((inp-least(inp, agent_first_input))*input_price) AS cost_growth,
    sum((outp-coalesce(rsn,0))*toFloat64OrZero($price_output)) AS cost_visible_output,
    sum(coalesce(rsn,0)*toFloat64OrZero($price_output)) AS cost_reasoning,
    argMinIf(inp, ts, agent=main_agent) AS inherited_context,
    if(countIf(agent=main_agent)>1, (argMaxIf(inp, ts, agent=main_agent)-argMinIf(inp, ts, agent=main_agent))/(countIf(agent=main_agent)-1), NULL) AS growth_per_step
  FROM task_calls GROUP BY harness, task_id
),
codex_model_time AS (
  SELECT attributes_string['turn_id'] AS task_id, sum(duration_nano)/1000000000 AS seconds
  FROM signoz_traces.distributed_signoz_index_v3
  WHERE timestamp BETWEEN fromUnixTimestamp64Nano($start_timestamp_nano) AND fromUnixTimestamp64Nano($end_timestamp_nano) AND serviceName IN $service_name AND serviceName IN ('codex-app-server','codex_exec','codex_cli_rs') AND name='run_sampling_request' AND attributes_string['turn_id']!=''
  GROUP BY task_id
),
reasoning_tasks AS (
  SELECT t.start_nano AS start_nano, t.end_nano AS end_nano, t.harness AS harness, t.native_session_id AS native_session_id, t.task_id AS task_id,
    t.provider AS provider, t.model AS model, t.effort AS effort, t.duration_seconds AS duration_seconds, t.delegations AS delegations,
    t.interrupted AS interrupted, t.errored AS errored, coalesce(c.model_steps,0) AS model_steps, coalesce(c.input_tokens,0) AS input_tokens, coalesce(c.cached_input,0) AS cached_input,
    coalesce(c.output_tokens,0) AS output_tokens,
    if(t.harness='claude-code', CAST(NULL AS Nullable(Float64)), c.reasoning_tokens) AS reasoning_tokens,
    if(t.harness IN ('codex-app-server','codex_exec','codex_cli_rs'), coalesce(m.seconds,0), coalesce(c.model_seconds,0)) AS model_seconds,
    coalesce(c.cost_inherited,0) AS cost_inherited, coalesce(c.cost_growth,0) AS cost_growth,
    coalesce(c.cost_visible_output,0) AS cost_visible_output, coalesce(c.cost_reasoning,0) AS cost_reasoning,
    coalesce(c.cost_inherited,0)+coalesce(c.cost_growth,0)+coalesce(c.cost_visible_output,0)+coalesce(c.cost_reasoning,0) AS cost_units,
    c.inherited_context AS inherited_context, c.growth_per_step AS growth_per_step
  FROM (SELECT * FROM codex_tasks UNION ALL SELECT * FROM omp_tasks UNION ALL SELECT * FROM claude_tasks) AS t
  LEFT JOIN task_costs AS c ON c.harness=t.harness AND c.task_id=t.task_id
  LEFT JOIN codex_model_time AS m ON m.task_id=t.task_id
),
task_outcomes AS (
  SELECT *, if(harness='codex_exec',NULL,toUInt8(next_start_nano>0 AND next_start_nano<=end_nano+600000000000)) AS quick_follow_up,
    if(harness='codex_exec',NULL,toUInt8(coalesce(interrupted,0)=0 AND coalesce(errored,0)=0 AND quick_follow_up=0)) AS clean_completion,
    multiIf(effort='low',1,effort='medium',2,effort='high',3,effort='xhigh',4,0) AS effort_rank
  FROM (
    SELECT *, leadInFrame(start_nano,1,toUInt64(0)) OVER (PARTITION BY harness,native_session_id ORDER BY start_nano ROWS BETWEEN CURRENT ROW AND 1 FOLLOWING) AS next_start_nano
    FROM reasoning_tasks
  )
)
, rates AS (
  SELECT harness, model, effort, any(effort_rank) AS rnk, countIf(isNotNull(clean_completion)) AS n,
    100*sumIf(clean_completion, isNotNull(clean_completion))/nullIf(n,0) AS rate, quantileExact(0.5)(cost_units) AS med_cost
  FROM task_outcomes WHERE effort_rank > 0 GROUP BY harness, model, effort HAVING n >= toUInt64OrZero($min_tasks)
),
best AS (
  SELECT harness, model, argMax(effort, rate) AS best_effort, max(rate) AS best_rate, argMax(n, rate) AS best_n, argMax(med_cost, rate) AS best_cost, count() AS levels
  FROM rates GROUP BY harness, model
)
SELECT multiIf(harness='codex-app-server','Codex App',harness='codex_exec','Codex Exec',harness='codex_cli_rs','Codex CLI',harness='oh-my-pi','OMP',harness='claude-code','Claude Code',harness) AS `Harness`, model AS `Model`, any(levels) AS `Levels compared`,
  any(best_effort) AS `Best effort`, round(any(best_rate),1) AS `Best success`, any(best_n) AS `Best tasks`,
  argMin(effort, rnk) AS `Lowest sufficient effort`, round(argMin(rate, rnk),1) AS `Its success`, argMin(n, rnk) AS `Its tasks`,
  round(100*(1 - argMin(med_cost, rnk)/nullIf(any(best_cost),0)),1) AS `Cost saving vs best`
FROM (
  SELECT b.harness AS harness, b.model AS model, b.levels AS levels, b.best_effort AS best_effort, b.best_rate AS best_rate, b.best_n AS best_n,
    b.best_cost AS best_cost, r.effort AS effort, r.rnk AS rnk, r.rate AS rate, r.n AS n, r.med_cost AS med_cost
  FROM best AS b INNER JOIN rates AS r ON r.harness=b.harness AND r.model=b.model
  WHERE r.rate >= b.best_rate - toFloat64OrZero($success_tolerance_pts)
)
GROUP BY harness, model
ORDER BY `Harness`, `Model`

widgets.title: Effort Ladder

widgets.description: A goal chain is a task plus every task that follows it in the same session within 10 minutes of the previous one ending: a proxy for one goal including its rework. Low effort can look cheap per task but cost more per goal if it needs follow-ups that re-read the whole session. Chain cost multiplier is total chain cost ÷ total first-task cost: how much follow-ups add on top of the first attempt. Codex Exec runs are excluded (no user in the loop). Cost units weight tokens by the dashboard price variables (uncached input, cached input, output; defaults are relative weights 1 : 0.1 : 8, not money). Inherited = re-reading context the agent already held when its first call in the task was made; growth = context added during the task; reasoning is billed at the output weight. Claude Code reports no reasoning tokens, so its thinking is inside visible output. Rows with fewer tasks than the min_tasks variable are flagged Low sample; read them as anecdotes.

task_outcomes AS (

chains AS (
  SELECT harness, native_session_id, chain_no, argMin(effort, start_nano) AS first_effort, count() AS tasks, sum(cost_units) AS chain_cost, argMin(cost_units, start_nano) AS first_cost

SELECT multiIf(harness='codex-app-server','Codex App',harness='codex_exec','Codex Exec',harness='codex_cli_rs','Codex CLI',harness='oh-my-pi','OMP',harness='claude-code','Claude Code',harness) AS `Harness`, first_effort AS `First effort`, count() AS `Chains`, if(count() < toUInt64OrZero($min_tasks), 'yes', 'no') AS `Low sample`,

  round(quantileExact(0.5)(chain_cost)) AS `Median chain cost`, round(sum(chain_cost)/nullIf(sum(first_cost),0),2) AS `Chain cost multiplier`
FROM chains
GROUP BY harness, first_effort
ORDER BY `Harness`, multiIf(first_effort='unset',0,first_effort='low',1,first_effort='medium',2,first_effort='high',3,first_effort='xhigh',4,5)

widgets.title: Goal Chains by First-Task Effort

widgets.description: Daily clean-completion share of tasks per effort. Each legend entry shows how many scored tasks that effort has across the selected range. Clean completion (proxy) = not interrupted, not ended on an error, and no new task in the same session within 10 minutes of it ending. It infers accepted work from absence of friction; it does not read prompt content. Headless Codex Exec runs have no user in the loop, so their clean completion and follow-up stay blank. Claude Code emits no interrupt event, so its clean completion is an upper bound. Days with few tasks are noisy. Ranges shorter than one day intentionally remain blank.

    coalesce(c.output_tokens,0) AS output_tokens,
    if(t.harness='claude-code', CAST(NULL AS Nullable(Float64)), c.reasoning_tokens) AS reasoning_tokens,
    if(t.harness IN ('codex-app-server','codex_exec','codex_cli_rs'), coalesce(m.seconds,0), coalesce(c.model_seconds,0)) AS model_seconds,
    coalesce(c.cost_inherited,0) AS cost_inherited, coalesce(c.cost_growth,0) AS cost_growth,
    coalesce(c.cost_visible_output,0) AS cost_visible_output, coalesce(c.cost_reasoning,0) AS cost_reasoning,
    coalesce(c.cost_inherited,0)+coalesce(c.cost_growth,0)+coalesce(c.cost_visible_output,0)+coalesce(c.cost_reasoning,0) AS cost_units,
    c.inherited_context AS inherited_context, c.growth_per_step AS growth_per_step
  FROM (SELECT * FROM codex_tasks UNION ALL SELECT * FROM omp_tasks UNION ALL SELECT * FROM claude_tasks) AS t
  LEFT JOIN task_costs AS c ON c.harness=t.harness AND c.task_id=t.task_id

  SELECT *, if(harness='codex_exec',NULL,toUInt8(next_start_nano>0 AND next_start_nano<=end_nano+600000000000)) AS quick_follow_up,

    multiIf(effort='low',1,effort='medium',2,effort='high',3,effort='xhigh',4,0) AS effort_rank
  FROM (
    SELECT *, leadInFrame(start_nano,1,toUInt64(0)) OVER (PARTITION BY harness,native_session_id ORDER BY start_nano ROWS BETWEEN CURRENT ROW AND 1 FOLLOWING) AS next_start_nano
    FROM reasoning_tasks
  )
)
, scored AS (SELECT * FROM task_outcomes WHERE isNotNull(clean_completion)),
totals AS (SELECT effort, count() AS n FROM scored GROUP BY effort)
SELECT toStartOfDay(fromUnixTimestamp64Nano(s.start_nano)) AS timestamp, concat(s.effort, ' (n=', toString(any(t.n)), ')') AS series, 100*avg(s.clean_completion) AS value
FROM scored AS s INNER JOIN totals AS t ON t.effort = s.effort
WHERE $end_timestamp_nano-$start_timestamp_nano >= 86400000000000
GROUP BY timestamp, s.effort
ORDER BY timestamp, series

  UNION ALL
  SELECT toUInt64(toUnixTimestamp64Nano(timestamp)) AS timestamp_nano, 'oh-my-pi' AS harness, multiIf(lower(attributes_string['gen_ai.provider.name']) LIKE '%anthropic%','Anthropic',lower(attributes_string['gen_ai.provider.name']) LIKE '%openai%','OpenAI',attributes_string['gen_ai.provider.name']) AS provider, attributes_string['gen_ai.request.model'] AS model,

omp_runs AS (

omp_tasks AS (
  SELECT r.start_nano AS start_nano, r.end_nano AS end_nano, 'oh-my-pi' AS harness, r.native_session_id AS native_session_id, r.task_id AS task_id,

    first_value(agent) OVER (PARTITION BY harness, task_id ORDER BY ts ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS main_agent,

  FROM (SELECT * FROM codex_calls UNION ALL SELECT * FROM omp_calls UNION ALL SELECT * FROM claude_calls)

    sum((inp-least(inp, agent_first_input))*input_price) AS cost_growth,
    sum((outp-coalesce(rsn,0))*toFloat64OrZero($price_output)) AS cost_visible_output,
    sum(coalesce(rsn,0)*toFloat64OrZero($price_output)) AS cost_reasoning,
    argMinIf(inp, ts, agent=main_agent) AS inherited_context,
    if(countIf(agent=main_agent)>1, (argMaxIf(inp, ts, agent=main_agent)-argMinIf(inp, ts, agent=main_agent))/(countIf(agent=main_agent)-1), NULL) AS growth_per_step

codex_model_time AS (
  SELECT attributes_string['turn_id'] AS task_id, sum(duration_nano)/1000000000 AS seconds
  FROM signoz_traces.distributed_signoz_index_v3

  GROUP BY task_id
),
reasoning_tasks AS (
  SELECT t.start_nano AS start_nano, t.end_nano AS end_nano, t.harness AS harness, t.native_session_id AS native_session_id, t.task_id AS task_id,
    t.provider AS provider, t.model AS model, t.effort AS effort, t.duration_seconds AS duration_seconds, t.delegations AS delegations,
    t.interrupted AS interrupted, t.errored AS errored, coalesce(c.model_steps,0) AS model_steps, coalesce(c.input_tokens,0) AS input_tokens, coalesce(c.cached_input,0) AS cached_input,
    coalesce(c.output_tokens,0) AS output_tokens,
    if(t.harness='claude-code', CAST(NULL AS Nullable(Float64)), c.reasoning_tokens) AS reasoning_tokens,
    if(t.harness IN ('codex-app-server','codex_exec','codex_cli_rs'), coalesce(m.seconds,0), coalesce(c.model_seconds,0)) AS model_seconds,
    coalesce(c.cost_inherited,0) AS cost_inherited, coalesce(c.cost_growth,0) AS cost_growth,
    coalesce(c.cost_visible_output,0) AS cost_visible_output, coalesce(c.cost_reasoning,0) AS cost_reasoning,
    coalesce(c.cost_inherited,0)+coalesce(c.cost_growth,0)+coalesce(c.cost_visible_output,0)+coalesce(c.cost_reasoning,0) AS cost_units,
    c.inherited_context AS inherited_context, c.growth_per_step AS growth_per_step
  FROM (SELECT * FROM codex_tasks UNION ALL SELECT * FROM omp_tasks UNION ALL SELECT * FROM claude_tasks) AS t
  LEFT JOIN task_costs AS c ON c.harness=t.harness AND c.task_id=t.task_id
  LEFT JOIN codex_model_time AS m ON m.task_id=t.task_id
),
task_outcomes AS (
  SELECT *, if(harness='codex_exec',NULL,toUInt8(next_start_nano>0 AND next_start_nano<=end_nano+600000000000)) AS quick_follow_up,
    if(harness='codex_exec',NULL,toUInt8(coalesce(interrupted,0)=0 AND coalesce(errored,0)=0 AND quick_follow_up=0)) AS clean_completion,
    multiIf(effort='low',1,effort='medium',2,effort='high',3,effort='xhigh',4,0) AS effort_rank
  FROM (
    SELECT *, leadInFrame(start_nano,1,toUInt64(0)) OVER (PARTITION BY harness,native_session_id ORDER BY start_nano ROWS BETWEEN CURRENT ROW AND 1 FOLLOWING) AS next_start_nano
    FROM reasoning_tasks
  )
)
SELECT multiIf(harness='codex-app-server','Codex App',harness='codex_exec','Codex Exec',harness='codex_cli_rs','Codex CLI',harness='oh-my-pi','OMP',harness='claude-code','Claude Code',harness) AS `Harness`, model AS `Model`, effort AS `Effort`, count() AS `Tasks`, if(count() < toUInt64OrZero($min_tasks), 'yes', 'no') AS `Low sample`,
  round(100*avg(clean_completion),1) AS `Clean completion`, round(100*avg(interrupted),1) AS `Interrupted`,
  round(quantileExact(0.5)(duration_seconds),1) AS `P50 duration`, round(avg(model_steps),1) AS `Avg model steps`,
  round(quantileExact(0.5)(cost_units)) AS `Median cost`,
  round(avg(reasoning_tokens)) AS `Avg reasoning tokens`, round(sum(reasoning_tokens)/nullIf(sum(model_steps),0)) AS `Reasoning per step`
FROM task_outcomes
GROUP BY harness,model,effort
ORDER BY `Harness`,`Model`,multiIf(effort='unset',0,effort='low',1,effort='medium',2,effort='high',3,effort='xhigh',4,5)

widgets.title: Model × Effort Comparison

widgets.description: The 50 most expensive tasks by price-weighted cost, for investigating over-thinking and long runs. Delegations count Oh My Pi subagent runs (advisors excluded). Quick follow-up means another task started in the same session within 10 minutes of this one ending. Cost units weight tokens by the dashboard price variables (uncached input, cached input, output; defaults are relative weights 1 : 0.1 : 8, not money). Inherited = re-reading context the agent already held when its first call in the task was made; growth = context added during the task; reasoning is billed at the output weight. Claude Code reports no reasoning tokens, so its thinking is inside visible output.

    sum(coalesce(rsn,0)*toFloat64OrZero($price_output)) AS cost_reasoning,
    argMinIf(inp, ts, agent=main_agent) AS inherited_context,
    if(countIf(agent=main_agent)>1, (argMaxIf(inp, ts, agent=main_agent)-argMinIf(inp, ts, agent=main_agent))/(countIf(agent=main_agent)-1), NULL) AS growth_per_step
  FROM task_calls GROUP BY harness, task_id
),
codex_model_time AS (
  SELECT attributes_string['turn_id'] AS task_id, sum(duration_nano)/1000000000 AS seconds
  FROM signoz_traces.distributed_signoz_index_v3
  WHERE timestamp BETWEEN fromUnixTimestamp64Nano($start_timestamp_nano) AND fromUnixTimestamp64Nano($end_timestamp_nano) AND serviceName IN $service_name AND serviceName IN ('codex-app-server','codex_exec','codex_cli_rs') AND name='run_sampling_request' AND attributes_string['turn_id']!=''
  GROUP BY task_id
),
reasoning_tasks AS (
  SELECT t.start_nano AS start_nano, t.end_nano AS end_nano, t.harness AS harness, t.native_session_id AS native_session_id, t.task_id AS task_id,
    t.provider AS provider, t.model AS model, t.effort AS effort, t.duration_seconds AS duration_seconds, t.delegations AS delegations,
    t.interrupted AS interrupted, t.errored AS errored, coalesce(c.model_steps,0) AS model_steps, coalesce(c.input_tokens,0) AS input_tokens, coalesce(c.cached_input,0) AS cached_input,
    coalesce(c.output_tokens,0) AS output_tokens,
    if(t.harness='claude-code', CAST(NULL AS Nullable(Float64)), c.reasoning_tokens) AS reasoning_tokens,
    if(t.harness IN ('codex-app-server','codex_exec','codex_cli_rs'), coalesce(m.seconds,0), coalesce(c.model_seconds,0)) AS model_seconds,
    coalesce(c.cost_inherited,0) AS cost_inherited, coalesce(c.cost_growth,0) AS cost_growth,
    coalesce(c.cost_visible_output,0) AS cost_visible_output, coalesce(c.cost_reasoning,0) AS cost_reasoning,
    coalesce(c.cost_inherited,0)+coalesce(c.cost_growth,0)+coalesce(c.cost_visible_output,0)+coalesce(c.cost_reasoning,0) AS cost_units,
    c.inherited_context AS inherited_context, c.growth_per_step AS growth_per_step
  FROM (SELECT * FROM codex_tasks UNION ALL SELECT * FROM omp_tasks UNION ALL SELECT * FROM claude_tasks) AS t
  LEFT JOIN task_costs AS c ON c.harness=t.harness AND c.task_id=t.task_id
  LEFT JOIN codex_model_time AS m ON m.task_id=t.task_id
),
task_outcomes AS (
  SELECT *, if(harness='codex_exec',NULL,toUInt8(next_start_nano>0 AND next_start_nano<=end_nano+600000000000)) AS quick_follow_up,
    if(harness='codex_exec',NULL,toUInt8(coalesce(interrupted,0)=0 AND coalesce(errored,0)=0 AND quick_follow_up=0)) AS clean_completion,
    multiIf(effort='low',1,effort='medium',2,effort='high',3,effort='xhigh',4,0) AS effort_rank
  FROM (
    SELECT *, leadInFrame(start_nano,1,toUInt64(0)) OVER (PARTITION BY harness,native_session_id ORDER BY start_nano ROWS BETWEEN CURRENT ROW AND 1 FOLLOWING) AS next_start_nano
    FROM reasoning_tasks
  )
)
SELECT formatDateTime(fromUnixTimestamp64Nano(start_nano),'%Y-%m-%d %H:%i') AS `Started`, harness AS `Harness`, native_session_id AS `Session`, model AS `Model`, effort AS `Effort`,
  round(duration_seconds,1) AS `Duration`, model_steps AS `Model steps`, delegations AS `Delegations`, round(cost_units) AS `Cost`, reasoning_tokens AS `Reasoning tokens`, output_tokens AS `Output tokens`,
  multiIf(isNull(interrupted),'n/a',interrupted=1,'yes','no') AS `Interrupted`, multiIf(isNull(quick_follow_up),'n/a',quick_follow_up=1,'yes','no') AS `Quick follow-up`
FROM task_outcomes
ORDER BY cost_units DESC
LIMIT 50
